_meta.title: Restricted categories patch — 27 entries to merge into master_restricted_reference.json
_meta.purpose: Upgrades 20 thin categories to full depth + adds 7 missing Amazon-official categories. Research sourced from Amazon G200164330, EPA, FDA, FCC, Ofcom, MHRA, CPSC, and compliance references (ComplianceGate, RetailAssured, SellerSonar, Brandwoven). Merge into master by replacing matching IDs and appending new ones.
_meta.action: Claude Code: load master_restricted_reference.json, replace each category by id match, append new ids, save. Do not touch the 18 existing full-depth categories.

categories.label: Pest control products, pesticides & biocides

marketplaces.US: GATED — EPA registration required under FIFRA
marketplaces.UK: GATED — HSE/CRD registration required under UK BPR (Biocidal Products Regulation)

prohibited_items: Unregistered pesticides (no EPA reg number in US, no HSE/CRD number in UK)
Products making public health claims (kills disease-causing pathogens) without registration
Pesticide products not intended for sale in that marketplace
categories.false_positive_warning: NON-pesticide products get flagged constantly by Amazon's automated scanner when listing copy contains ANY of the trigger keywords. A cleaning cloth described as 'antibacterial' or oil described as 'anti-corrosion' can trigger a pesticide review. This is the MOST COMMON source of false-positive Restricted Product violations for arbitrage/reselling sellers. The claims screener must catch these words regardless of product category.
your_violations: Mil-Gear lubricant flagged for pesticide-claim language in listing copy (v8 session)

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED — must comply with TSCA Title VI / CARB Phase 2 formaldehyde standards
marketplaces.UK: Allowed — no equivalent formaldehyde-specific regulation, but general product safety applies

thresholds.testing_standard: ASTM E1333-16 (large chamber) or ASTM D6007 (small chamber)
thresholds.certification: EPA-recognized TSCA Title VI Third-Party Certifier (TPC)

US: TSCA Title VI / CARB Phase 2 certification
Product labeling as TSCA Title VI compliant
UK: No specific formaldehyde regulation but REACH applies

marketplaces.US: GATED — flammability + formaldehyde + tip-over + law label requirements
marketplaces.UK: GATED — Furniture and Furnishings (Fire Safety) Regulations 1988 as amended

US: CARB Phase 2 certification for composite wood components
US Law Label (filling materials, manufacturer info)
UK: Fire Safety Regulations 1988 compliance label (display label + permanent label)

categories.label: Opaque / light-blocking eyewear & goggles

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED — FDA considers non-transparent eyewear a medical device risk
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — general product safety, PPE Regulation 2016/425 if marketed as protective

your_violations: B0H4NJN5BM — opaque light-blocking goggles/eyeshields, PROHIBITED (FDA requires see-through eyewear)

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED except pre-approved wine sellers; beer/spirits fully prohibited
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — alcohol listings allowed with age verification; must comply with Licensing Act 2003

categories.label: Explosives, weapons & related items

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED — firearms, ammunition, explosives, fireworks; some non-lethal accessories allowed

prohibited_items: All firearms and firearm parts (receivers, frames, triggers, silencers, bump stocks)
Explosives and fireworks of any kind
Disguised weapons (pen knives designed as weapons, credit card knives)
allowed_exceptions: Gun safes and cabinets
Cleaning kits (non-specific)
Hunting accessories (scopes, bipods — varies by marketplace)
Airsoft guns (UK: with orange tip, age-restricted)

categories.label: Drugs, OTC medicines & drug paraphernalia

marketplaces.US: GATED — OTC drugs must have FDA Drug Facts label; prescription drugs PROHIBITED
marketplaces.UK: GATED — OTC medicines via MHRA registered sellers only; pharmacy-only medicines (P) require registered pharmacy; prescription-only (POM) PROHIBITED

prohibited_items: Controlled substances (Schedule I-V US, Class A-C UK)
Drug paraphernalia (bongs, dab rigs, purity test kits, crack pipes)
Products containing scheduled substances (codeine, ephedrine above thresholds)

UK: MHRA registration as online seller of medicines
THR (Traditional Herbal Registration) number if herbal

categories.label: Tobacco, e-cigarettes & vaping products

marketplaces.US: PROHIBITED — all tobacco, nicotine, e-cigarettes, vaping devices, e-liquids
marketplaces.UK: MOSTLY PROHIBITED — nicotine e-liquids prohibited; nicotine-free e-cigarette devices allowed with safety compliance; all tobacco products prohibited

prohibited_items: All tobacco products (cigarettes, cigars, pipe tobacco, chewing tobacco, snuff, snus)
All nicotine-containing e-liquids and refill cartridges
E-cigarette devices (US — all; UK — only if nicotine-containing)
Herbal cigarettes / herbal smoking mix containing tobacco or nicotine

US: FDA-approved nicotine replacement therapy (patches, gum, lozenges) — but GATED under drugs_otc
UK: Nicotine-free e-cigarette devices (must comply with safety standards)
Smoking cessation products approved by MHRA
Vaping accessories (cases, stands) that contain no nicotine/tobacco

UK_nicotine_free_devices: MHRA notification (must appear on MHRA Notified Products list)

categories.label: Animals & animal-related products

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED — live animals prohibited except certain aquarium species, insects, shellfish
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — live animals prohibited; CITES applies to endangered species products

prohibited_items: Live animals (except aquarium species, certain insects, shellfish/crustaceans in US)
Products containing ivory from any animal
Products from endangered/CITES-listed species (rhinoceros, tiger, pangolin, etc.)
Shark fins, whale meat, dolphin/porpoise parts
Tools for ear cropping, tail docking, declawing
Products violating Lacey Act / Migratory Bird Treaty Act
Real fur products (California ban applies to Amazon US)
allowed_exceptions: Faux/synthetic animal products
Ethically sourced leather goods (must prove legal sourcing on request)
Pet food and treats (FDA compliant, separate gating)
Brine shrimp / sea monkey hatch kits (shipped dry/dormant)
Live worms and live bait

US: Lacey Act declaration for plant/animal materials
Certificate of legal sourcing on request
UK: Control of Trade in Endangered Species Regulations

categories.label: Fine art

marketplaces.US: GATED — Amazon Fine Art Store requires pre-approval

prohibited_items: NFT-linked physical art without proper rights documentation

UK: Artist Resale Right compliance (droit de suite) for secondary sales of works by living/recently deceased artists

categories.label: Currency, coins, cash equivalents & gift cards

marketplaces.US: GATED — Collectible Coins requires pre-approval; counterfeit/altered currency PROHIBITED
marketplaces.UK: GATED — same rules; Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981

prohibited_items: Commemorative medals misrepresented as legal tender

categories.label: Recalled products
categories.detail: Any product subject to a recall by CPSC (US), OPSS (UK), or RAPEX (EU) is PROHIBITED. Amazon actively scans for recalled ASINs and removes them. Sellers listing recalled products face immediate listing removal and potential account suspension. Check CPSC.gov (US), product-safety-alerts.beis.gov.uk (UK), and Safety Gate RAPEX (EU) before sourcing.

US: Product not on active recall list
UK: Product not on active recall list

categories.label: Gambling & lottery
allowed_exceptions: Non-functional slot machines for display/decoration
Toy slot machines (clearly marketed as toys)
Card game supplies (poker chips, playing cards)
Board games involving fictional gambling mechanics

categories.label: Warranties, service plans & contracts
categories.detail: Only Amazon-authorized providers can list warranties and service plans. Third-party sellers cannot list standalone warranty products without Amazon's pre-approval. Product warranties included with physical products (manufacturer warranty) are fine — it's standalone warranty-as-a-product listings that are restricted.

UK: Same; must also comply with Consumer Rights Act 2015

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED — state e-waste laws vary; some states require recycling programs
marketplaces.UK: RESTRICTED — WEEE Regulations 2013; producers must register with approved compliance scheme

UK: WEEE producer registration with Environment Agency

categories.label: Postage meters & stamps
allowed_exceptions: Collectible stamps (philately — with approval)
Used/cancelled stamps for collection
Stamp albums and accessories

categories.label: Offensive & controversial materials
categories.detail: Amazon reserves the right to determine what is offensive. Products promoting hatred, violence, racial/religious/sexual intolerance, or glorifying human suffering are prohibited. This includes but is not limited to: hate group merchandise, crime scene photos, products trivializing human tragedies, and products promoting illegal activity. Amazon's determination is final and subjective.
prohibited_items: Products promoting hatred or violence against any group
Products glorifying human suffering or tragedies
Products with profane or vulgar content (marketplace-dependent)

categories.label: Strike anywhere matches
categories.detail: Amazon prohibits all strike-anywhere matches — matches that can be ignited by friction against any rough surface, not just a designated striker. Safety matches (requiring the specific striker on the box) are allowed but classified as hazmat for shipping and require FBA dangerous goods enrollment.
allowed_exceptions: Safety matches (FBA dangerous goods program required)

categories.label: CPAP cleaning & disinfecting devices
categories.detail: The FDA has NOT approved or cleared any ozone-gas or UV-light device for cleaning CPAP equipment. The FDA communicated directly to Amazon that these are unapproved medical devices. Both ozone and UV CPAP cleaners are PROHIBITED regardless of brand. CPAP machines themselves (the breathing devices) require 510(k) clearance and fall under medical_devices.
prohibited_items: Any device marketed to clean/sanitize/disinfect CPAP equipment

categories.label: Polystyrene foam (state-level restrictions)

marketplaces.US: RESTRICTED in some states — Washington, Maine, Maryland, others ban expanded polystyrene food containers
marketplaces.UK: No specific ban but general single-use plastics restrictions apply

categories.detail: Several US states ban expanded polystyrene (EPS) foam food service containers. Amazon may restrict listings that ship to those states. Not a federal ban but state-level enforcement varies. Most relevant for food service packaging sellers.

categories.label: Electronics (general)

marketplaces.US: GATED for some subcategories — FCC compliance required for RF-emitting devices
marketplaces.UK: GATED — UKCA/CE marking, EMC Regulations, LVD, RoHS, WEEE

prohibited_items: Devices that bypass copyright protection (mod chips, circumvention devices)
Radar detectors (some US states / UK prohibited in use)
Devices interfering with other devices' radio frequency

UK: UKCA marking (or CE until transitional period ends)

categories.label: Human parts & burial artifacts
prohibited_items: Human body parts, organs, remains, waste, or fluids
Historical grave markers from protected lands
Artifacts taken from protected archaeological sites
allowed_exceptions: Human skulls, bones, and skeletons for medical/educational use (where permitted by local law)
Human hair products including wigs
Dental/medical models (synthetic)

categories.label: Export controls
categories.detail: Products subject to US Export Administration Regulations (EAR), International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), or UK Export Control Act 2002 may not be sold to certain countries/entities. Amazon prohibits products from sanctioned countries (North Korea, Cuba, Syria, Iran, Crimea, DNR/LNR). Encryption software, military/dual-use technology, and certain advanced electronics fall under export controls.
prohibited_items: Products from North Korea, Cuba, Syria, Iran, Crimea, DNR/LNR
EAR-controlled dual-use items without proper classification

categories.label: Art — Home decor
categories.detail: Home decor art is less restricted than fine art but must not infringe intellectual property. Wall decals, murals, and decorative art that reproduce copyrighted images without license are prohibited. Original designs and properly licensed reproductions are allowed.
prohibited_items: Items infringing on character/brand IP (Disney, Marvel, etc.)

categories.label: Subscriptions & periodicals
categories.detail: Subscription products and periodicals require Amazon approval. Auto-renewing subscriptions must comply with consumer protection rules around clear pricing, cancellation rights, and billing transparency. Subscribe & Save is Amazon's own program with separate enrollment.

UK: Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 compliance (14-day cancellation right)

categories.label: Prohibited product claims (cross-category)
categories.detail: This is NOT a product category — it's a CROSS-CUTTING policy. Amazon prohibits certain CLAIMS in listing copy regardless of product category. These claims trigger automated scanning and can result in Restricted Product violations even on perfectly legal products. This is the single biggest source of false-positive violations for sellers.
